text:
zoe: Morning! Quick question  who ate the last box of tea bags? Found an open tin with only one chamomile left. Can we please agree on a replacement rule? :tea:
mike: That was me, guilty. I forgot to replace after my late-night brew. Sorry. I can grab a new box on my way home.
anita: No worries. Maybe a simple rule: if you finish a shared consumable, leave a sticky note and add $3 to the pantry kitty. Helps keep things tidy.
carlos: Or we do a weekly runner rotation. Whoever is on duty buys staples. Keeps Venmo balance predictable.
zoe: Rotation sounds good. Also can we have a small tin labeled "communal tea" and one labeled "personal" so loose bags don't get mixed?
kitchen-bot: Suggestion recorded: "tea tin labels + rotation schedule". Create poll? React with :+1: to support.
mike: +1 to rotation. I'll take week 2 of April.
anita: I'll volunteer for week 3. Also, reminder: please reseal opened honey jar. Last week someone left it open and it attracted fruit flies. :pray:
carlos: Yikes. I'll bring a honey dipper and some resealable jars.
zoe: Thanks! Small PSA: if you put butter back in the communal fridge, please write your initials and date. Someone left salted butter without a label and it got used for both savory and pastry. Some people noticed the taste clash.
kitchen-bot: Note: request submitted for "small labeled tins + honey dipper". Ticket #4352.
mike: I'll pick up a mixed tea sampler and replace the tin. ETA 18:45. Leaving a note on the fridge that tea is refilled by mike.
anita: Thanks Mike! Also proposing a one-line fridge etiquette sign: "Label, cool, replace if last." Short and effective.
carlos: Love it. Print and stick by the fridge. I'll laminate it if someone covers the cost from the kitty.
zoe: Done. I'll make the sign and the tiny tin labels tonight. Free Earl Grey for anyone who helps stick labels tomorrow morning. :grin:
